author: FlowExecutor
description: MCP server for the Flow best-execution swap quote API on Base. Gives AI agents multi-venue swap quotes (Uniswap V3, PancakeSwap V3, Aerodrome) with edge, liquidity flags, block number and latency metadata. Includes a local starter wallet with x402 auto-pay (hard spend caps) and a $0.05 seed pilot.
name: @flowexecutor/flow-mcp

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp index.js dist/index.js && echo build-ok
